feature: Native translation cancellation and installed-pair ownership

scenarios.name: Cancel an owned native request without freeing its occupied worker
scenarios.given: an installed translation pair has an active request whose native completion is delayed
scenarios.when: the user cancels and tries another request before the old operation returns
scenarios.then: cancellation reaches the exact native request once, no replacement native operation starts until it exits, and its late text is rejected

scenarios.name: Propagate caller cancellation and cancel delayed pair readiness
scenarios.given: a translation task is waiting for installed-pair readiness or native completion
scenarios.when: the caller task is cancelled or the user cancels before readiness returns
scenarios.then: an active native request is cancelled, a cancelled readiness check never starts native translation, and late text never returns as a successful result

scenarios.name: Preserve exact installed language selection and original text
scenarios.given: the adapter reports an installed English to Simplified Chinese pair or a pair needing setup or unsupported
scenarios.when: translation is requested with the original text and explicit language identifiers
scenarios.then: only the installed pair constructs a native request using the exact original text and language identifiers; unavailable pairs cannot translate or download, with real installed-model output acceptance recorded separately
